summary: T3-01 meets every acceptance criterion. All three checks pass: test_config.py (93 tests), test_geometry.py (20 tests) and make check (ruff, format and mypy). The diff stays inside the story's files, and config/run.yaml is untouched. I found no blocker or high finding. I judged the failing-first criterion from commit order only, because I did not read the progress notes.

checks.criterion: Tests written first and failing before implementation (test_config.py and test_geometry.py)
checks.evidence: Commit e818113 adds only the two test files, and its message says both fail at collection because the modules don't exist. The implementation commits (e317365, 069e0a9) come after it. I did not read the failing-run record in the notes, so this rests on commit order alone.

checks.criterion: pyproject gains numpy, scipy, pyyaml (+types-PyYAML dev); uv.lock updated
checks.evidence: The diff adds numpy, pyyaml and scipy plus a dev group with types-pyyaml, and nothing else. uv.lock changes by +62 lines. `make check` runs `uv run --locked` and passes.

checks.criterion: config.py loads the nine terrain and targets values, and a test asserts them against run.yaml
checks.evidence: 93 passed. test_loader_returns_exactly_what_run_yaml_holds compares the loader output against a direct yaml.safe_load of config/run.yaml. test_committed_terrain_values_are_pinned checks 90, [270,360,540,720,1080], 4, 4, (none, plane), 0.8, aeqd_sphere, 5000 and 2500. run.yaml lines 21-30 hold the same values.

checks.criterion: Loader rejects unknown resampler, missing key and non-positive grid with named errors; kickoff nulls stay None and are never defaulted
checks.evidence: config.py defines UnknownResamplerError, MissingConfigKeyError and NonPositiveValueError (config.py:77-98). _required raises on null terrain settings (config.py:218-222). RunConfig.value returns other entries unchanged, including null, as None (config.py:146-153). The null_paths test helper walks every null leaf.

checks.criterion: geometry.py BODY_RADII_M is Moon 1737400.0, Mars 3396190.0, Earth 6371008.8 (float64); an unknown body raises
checks.evidence: geometry.py:18-25 holds a read-only MappingProxyType with exactly the three values. body_radius_m raises UnknownBodyError on any other name (geometry.py:36-46). 20 tests passed.

checks.criterion: mypy --strict and ruff pass on the new files
checks.evidence: ruff check: All checks passed. ruff format: 8 files already formatted. mypy: no issues found in 8 source files.

findings.claim: DEFAULT_RUN_CONFIG finds config/run.yaml by walking up parents[3] from the module file, so it only works from the editable workspace install.
findings.evidence: The docstring at config.py:45-49 says to pass a path explicitly anywhere else. The test test_default_path_is_the_repository_run_yaml passes. This is acceptable and optional to change.
